name: Darth Revan and Darth Malak return; the Jedi Civil War begins
summary: A year after vanishing, the heroes of the Mandalorian Wars returned at the head of a Star Forge fleet as Darth Revan and Darth Malak, with half the Republic's veterans behind them. They declared a Sith Empire and struck at the Republic they had saved.

name: Revan reopens the Sith Academy on Korriban
summary: Revan established an academy in Dreshdae to turn fallen Jedi and ambitious Force-sensitives into Sith, ruled by Uthar Wynn and policed by the tombs of the Valley of the Dark Lords. It fed officers to his war and later tore itself apart.

name: The Sith overrun the Outer Rim

location.note: a swath of the northern and eastern Rim

summary: With the Star Forge producing warships faster than any shipyard, Revan's fleets rolled up Republic worlds across the Rim while deliberately sparing their industry. Revan meant to rule an intact galaxy, not a ruined one.

name: Manaan sells kolto to both sides
summary: The Selkath of Manaan declared strict neutrality and sold the healing fluid kolto to Republic and Sith alike, forcing both to keep embassies in Ahto City under pain of losing supply. The arrangement held until the kolto wars that followed.

name: Saul Karath bombards Telos IV
summary: To prove his loyalty after defecting from the Republic, Admiral Saul Karath turned his fleet's guns on Telos IV and burned its surface to ash. Carth Onasi, a native, never forgave him.

name: Sith occupation of Taris
summary: Revan's Sith seized Taris as a forward base, garrisoning its upper city and leaving the Undercity to the swoop gangs and rakghouls. It would be the last place the two Dark Lords held together.

name: Malak fires on Revan's flagship

location.note: aboard Revan's flagship during a Jedi boarding action

summary: A Jedi strike team led by Bastila Shan boarded Revan's flagship to capture him. As they fought on the bridge, Malak ordered his own ship to fire on his master's, hoping to kill Revan and the Jedi together and take the throne.

name: Darth Revan conquers the Republic
summary: Speculative. Undivided and still armed with the Star Forge, Revan's Sith would have forced the Republic to capitulate within a year or two, taking its worlds and industry intact as Revan always intended.
basis: Kreia in Knights of the Old Republic II and the novel Revan both say Revan was preserving the Republic's infrastructure to rule it, and that the Republic was losing before Malak's betrayal split the Sith leadership.

name: Bastila Shan captures the broken Revan
summary: Malak's barrage left Revan near death on the bridge. Bastila kept him alive with the Force, forging a bond between them, and carried him back to the Jedi as the greatest prize of the war.

name: Malak proclaims himself Dark Lord of the Sith
summary: Believing Revan dead, Malak took the title of Dark Lord and the loyalty of the Star Forge fleet. Where Revan had conquered to rule, Malak conquered to destroy, and the war became far bloodier.

name: The Jedi Council remakes Revan's mind
summary: Rather than execute the Dark Lord, the Council on Dantooine suppressed Revan's memories and overlaid a new identity, hoping to use him to find the Star Forge. The decision would be debated by Jedi for generations.

name: Malak's war of annihilation

location.note: the Sith front line against the Republic

summary: Malak abandoned Revan's restraint and began bombarding worlds into submission, killing the Republic's will to resist rather than its ability. Republic morale cracked, but so did the loyalty of Sith who had followed Revan for a better galaxy.

name: The Endar Spire is destroyed over Taris
summary: A Sith ambush over occupied Taris destroyed the Republic cruiser carrying Bastila Shan and the amnesiac Revan. Both reached the surface in escape pods, and the Sith sealed the planet to hunt for Bastila.

name: Malak destroys Taris
summary: When Bastila's party slipped through the blockade, Malak ordered the Sith fleet to level Taris rather than let her escape. The city-world that had survived the Mandalorians was reduced to ruins within hours.

name: Revan is retrained as a Jedi on Dantooine
summary: At the Dantooine Enclave the Council took the amnesiac soldier as a Padawan and set him to follow the Force vision he shared with Bastila: a Rakatan Star Map hidden in the grasslands, the first step toward the Star Forge.

name: The hunt for the Star Maps

location.note: Dantooine, Kashyyyk, Manaan, Tatooine and Korriban

summary: Aboard the Ebon Hawk, Revan's new companions retraced his old path through the Rakatan Star Maps, freeing Kashyyyk from Czerka, surviving Sith plots on Manaan and infiltrating the Korriban academy along the way.

name: Malak destroys the Jedi Enclave on Dantooine
summary: Learning that the Jedi were sheltering Revan on Dantooine, Malak bombed the Enclave from orbit, killing most of the Jedi there. The ruins stood empty until the Exile returned in 3,951 BBY.

name: Aboard the Leviathan, Revan learns who he is
summary: Captured by Saul Karath, the Ebon Hawk's crew escaped and Carth Onasi killed the admiral. Malak then confronted the amnesiac Jedi face to face and told him the truth: he was Darth Revan. Bastila sacrificed herself to let the others escape.

name: Revan chooses the light at the Temple of the Ancients
summary: On Lehon, a fallen Bastila offered Revan the chance to reclaim his throne and rule the galaxy with her. He refused, and the former Dark Lord led the Republic's assault on the Star Forge instead.

name: Darth Revan reclaims the Star Forge
summary: Speculative. Had Revan accepted Bastila's offer, the two would have stormed the Star Forge, killed Malak and turned the Rakatan factory's fleets against the Republic armada gathered at Lehon.
basis: This is the dark-side ending of Knights of the Old Republic, in which Revan kills Malak aboard the Star Forge and is hailed as Dark Lord by the Sith fleet.

name: Battle of Rakata Prime
summary: The Republic fleet under Admiral Dodonna attacked the Star Forge while Revan boarded it. He brought Bastila back to the light, so that her battle meditation turned the fight, and killed Darth Malak at the station's heart.

name: Destruction of the Star Forge
summary: With its defenders dead and its disruptor field down, the Republic fleet poured fire into the Star Forge until the ancient Rakatan factory broke apart over Lehon. The Sith lost their fleet, their leader and their reason to fight in a single day.

name: Collapse of Darth Revan's Sith Empire
summary: Leaderless and cut off from the Star Forge's endless ships, the Sith Empire fell apart into feuding admirals and academy factions. The Republic reclaimed its lost worlds but was too exhausted to hunt down every remnant.

name: The Korriban academy destroys itself
summary: With Malak dead, the Sith of Korriban turned on each other in a civil war that emptied the academy and left the Valley of the Dark Lords to tomb robbers. The surviving lords drifted toward Malachor V and the Triumvirate.

name: The Republic honours the heroes of the Star Forge
summary: On the beaches of Lehon the Republic awarded the Cross of Glory to Revan and the Ebon Hawk's crew. The Prodigal Knight who had nearly destroyed the Republic was briefly its most celebrated defender.

name: The Jedi Council casts out Kreia
summary: Blamed for training Revan and the other Jedi who fell, the historian and Master Kreia was expelled from the Order. She followed Revan's trail to Malachor V to understand what had changed him.

name: Kreia takes the Trayus Academy and becomes Darth Traya
summary: At the Trayus Academy on the ruined Malachor V, Kreia embraced the Sith teachings Revan had found there and took the name Darth Traya, Lord of Betrayal. The Sith who gathered to her would become the Triumvirate.
